headline: Pineapple cake concept stock Wei Ge Bakery confirms termination of emerging stock trading on 10/20 - Liberty Times Finance
summary: Wei Ge Bakery voluntarily applied to terminate trading of its shares on the Emerging Stock Market. The Taipei Exchange said trading will end from October 20, after its share price fell from NT$10.6 to NT$4.88.
why: Emerging-market listings on the Taipei Exchange are a smaller segment for early-stage companies, and delisting removes liquidity for their shareholders.
